## Definition of Done

- [ ] Plan acceptance criteria met (or "no plan: small change")
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] `pnpm test:integration` passes (database changes) and `pnpm db:generate` shows no drift (schema changes)
- [ ] Documents listed in the plan updated
- [ ] `docs/status.md` replaced and `docs/history.md` entry added
- [ ] `README.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] Plan marked Done with its Completion record filled in
